engine.threads: CRYPTO_AR_GF2_THREADS=2 (<= 3; lowered because another CERTBIN executor shares the 4-core machine)

slots.xr144: U62 (listed order, ascending idx), then S62, then C20 of instance-sets.json; slot 0..143

fresh.N-CONV: kept Qpart(x_R); bits = g.integers(0, 2, size=|S_L|) on S_L; identity E_S3(x_R) rejected
fresh.N-CONVL: kept Qpart + Lpart; bits = g.integers(0, 2, size=|S_L cap col 0|) on the constant positions; identity (B's own bits) and b' = 0 rejected; b' logged
fresh.N-CONV17: kept Q_k = sum_{i+j=k} v_i v_{9+j}; bits on S_L as N-CONV
fresh.N-ELL144: o2-declaration draw: M[Upos] = g.integers(0, 2, size=Upos.size); c = int(g.integers(0, 2)); rows 0..15 kept; row 16 := v_0 + v_9 + c

keep_rule: per slot, attempts a = 0..255: one draw; rejections (identity, b' = 0, duplicate of an already-kept system of the same arm by E_sha256); then s by exhaustive 2^18 evaluation; first s = 0 -> unsatisfiable instance; first s >= 1 -> satisfiable control; others discarded; stop when both filled; unfilled after attempt 255 -> EXHAUSTED(cap), never redrawn
phases: 0 C-ENGINE, C-SRC, C-SELF, C-FIX; trial plan hashed
1 archived arms, C-CONSTRUCT, C-SUPPORT, C-REG (a)-(d), C-ELL on S3-*
2 fresh draws, keep rules, draw logs
3 rc_b (R'_3, R'_4); predictions-t5.jsonl.gz written and hashed
4 M_4, W_4, W'_4; flat-v1 and wdag-v1 certificates; C-TOP, C-T4, C-WDAG; negative controls

power_table.method: exact rationals (fractions.Fraction, math.comb); decimal via mpmath at 60 digits

pre_data_readings.R1_keys: fresh systems are keyed '<ARM>:<slot>:<role>' (role unsat|sat) because each slot keeps two systems; archived arms keep the RC-1 keys; NELL-A20 systems are 'NELL-A20:<label>'
pre_data_readings.R2_rejected_draws: a rejected attempt is logged with s = null (s is computed only for non-rejected draws)
pre_data_readings.R3_certificate_lines: one line per (system, closure, format): M_4 flat-v1 (engine); W_4 flat-v1 (engine, counts toward W_4 only if max |mu| <= 2, never used for w); W_4 wdag-v1 (extractor, the only format counted for w)
pre_data_readings.R4_uncertified: an engine W_4 refutation with no wdag-v1 submitted (extractor failure)
pre_data_readings.R5_NC-DR-5_population: the NC-DR-5 label is issued on the arm's unsatisfiable systems; satisfiable controls and the union are reported beside it; per system the reference profile is the substituted [0,0,16,288,2328] if rc_b substitutes, the unsubstituted M_4 [0,0,17,323,2771] if the kernel dimension is 0, and no reference otherwise (counted as not matching)
pre_data_readings.R6_C-VERIFIER_kinds: a kind is (closure, arm) with >= 1 engine refutation under that closure; kinds with no refutation under a closure are empty, not vacuous; type (c) for M_4 uses the arm's W_4 flat certificates with max |mu| = 3 relabelled as M_4 (vacuous if the arm has none); type (c) for W_4 uses such a flat certificate as a one-node wdag, else a wdag with an added degree-4 child
pre_data_readings.R7_archived_closures: M_3, M_4 and W_4 of archived arms are computed in phase 1 (needed for C-REG) and reused as their phase-4 records; their wdag-v1 extraction and W'_4 run in phase 4
pre_data_readings.R8_NC-DR-4_rule3: rule (3) 'MIXED in every other case' is applied literally, also when NC-DR-1 is UNDETERMINED
pre_data_readings.R9_CP95: exact Clopper-Pearson by bisection on exact binomial tails at 60 digits (mpmath)
pre_data_readings.R10_C-DET_c: the 20 systems of C-DET (b) are recomputed a second time with threads = 1
